'''2007 Dagobah Regionals Frank Lam DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Frank Lam]] at [[2007 Dagobah Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Frank Cam
* '''Deck name:''' KTOD Senate
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
